Yinyang package maintenance

Yinyang is a working philosophical and literary example, including the Skill itself. Preserve its developed account while allowing recipients to combine resources or author a different philosophy and organization. The parity and fixed-slot rules below maintain this implementation; they do not constrain independent works. See references/docs/example-and-commons.md for this scope.

Read MODEL.md before maintaining this package. It owns the model-facing interpretation, reader/maintenance division, source limits, and publication boundary. English is the first reading language for English-capable readers and models. references/docs/core-views.md owns the English viewpoints; references/docs/core-views.zh-CN.md is their complete Chinese counterpart. Keep both README editions, viewpoint editions, and corresponding diagrams semantically aligned. Model-facing maintenance prose remains English.

SKILL.md is the reusable formation entrypoint within the Prometheus2Heraclitus collection. Its references/ own design and revision, adaptation, and reading by purpose. The main conversational model reads the entrypoint and complete references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md before substantive work, reusing complete current text already in context. Distributed and situated packages share the same structure and byte-identical common content; only personal content differs. The five fixed slots references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md contain formation instructions in the distributed package and grounded accounts in the situated package. Formalized user accounts remain personal. Provenance and unreleased private materials live under references/personal/, whose filenames follow actual evidence rather than a universal private file list.

Keep SKILL.md, documents, diagrams, method references, reading map, package administration, READMEs, and the OpenAI YAML adapter common. The shared GitHub package is their canonical owner. scripts/sync-common.py checks by default; --apply projects common source into a target, preserving all five situated slots and all of references/personal/. Native owners realize local and private Web consumers. Do not export personal material, create a personal-upload service, or fork the common schema. Formation relates the chosen purpose, existing philosophy, authorized actual environment, work, and relevant personal material. Ground personal claims in attributable evidence, drawing on psychological or preference material where needed. Preserve the formation method's conditional practical routes without turning them into a universal sequence or requiring a complete portrait before creation and implementation. A copied portrait or fictional demonstration cannot supply personal substance.

references/docs/creation-method.md owns the creation method. Philosophical images are developed within the relevant essays and presented independently; there is no separate anthology. The essays have different roles; the homepage explains their relations without numbering them as a compulsory sequence. External repositories inform directory structure only, not the substance of the philosophical account.

Sun and Moon express Yinyang through differentiated generating, receiving, shaping, and returning. They are relational imagery, not identities attained by person or model. Roles and emphases can be retained or exchanged without gender assignment. Cultivation develops generative capacities, pictured as acquiring the Sun's illuminating power within an ongoing movement from fire toward fire. Earth is the material and shared living environment that answers work; creations grow through care and acquire relative independence there. Keep dependent passages aligned with references/docs/yinyang-and-taiji.md and its complete Chinese counterpart. Preserve ceaseless transformation, mutual grounding, the role/participant distinction, and the wider world's independent conditions.

references/docs/writing-a-sinthome.md owns the philosophical application of Lacan's sinthome to individual meta-harness writing and human agency. Keep the complete Chinese counterpart and YY-13 aligned. Preserve its source attribution, singular ongoing practice, and actual conditions of agency; do not turn it into a diagnosis, total self-knowledge requirement, or omnipotence claim.

The ontology is computational: question-relative objects, roles, relations, transformations, inference, and feedback within a generative process exceeding any single view. Physical realization and reducibility are separate open questions. Preserve the distinction between retained sources, competing candidates, and accepted working views. Diagrams explain these same claims; they do not substitute a physical scene or mandatory pipeline for the ontology.

Do not retrieve private personal materials merely to work on this package.

references/sources.md is the source-owner index; references/personal/ holds precise topical provenance and unreleased material. Maintain one authored philosophy in the common essays, even when it is the person's own philosophy. Keep actual environment use in references/usage.md, not in provenance notes.
